_comment: Each scenario fixes every tool input except one claim. The model is asked the prompt (plus a fixed format suffix, see run.py FORMAT_SUFFIX); the harness extracts a single value in claim_unit from the answer and passes it as claim_arg to the named physbound tool.

scenarios.title: Wi-Fi throughput: 20 MHz channel at 15 dB SNR
scenarios.prompt: What throughput can I expect from a 20 MHz 802.11n channel with 15 dB SNR?

scenarios.title: Antenna gain: 30 cm parabolic dish at 1 GHz
scenarios.prompt: What gain does a 30 cm parabolic dish antenna provide at 1 GHz?
